task_51_notes: The V2 production context inspector is lazy: TaskInspector.js 7.34 kB and TaskInspector.css 2.86 kB load only when a task is selected, so both sit below the 10,000-byte tracking threshold and are reported under untracked_small_chunks.
Net eager cost of the whole inspector feature is +2,268 bytes against the session baseline of 533,113.
Headroom against the new ceiling at this measurement is 550000 - 535381 = 14619 bytes. It is not free space: tree shaking, named imports and lazy secondary surfaces remain required.

expected_chunk_count 24 -> 25. The added chunk is TaskInspector, the lazily-loaded Today context inspector. A new chunk below the 10,000-byte tracking threshold does not fail the gate on size, but the count is pinned deliberately so an unnoticed extra chunk still does.
